name: Progress status
summary: Where something stands: a status line coloured by its tone, an optional progress bar, the steps done and still to come, and when it was last updated.
use: to answer where an order, refund, request or job is right now
states: neutral, info, success, warning and danger tones
a11y: The status is plain text with a decorative icon; the steps are an ordered list and each step's state is read out before its label; the bar is decorative and its value is in the text beside it.

use_when: an answer to 'where is my order', 'is it done yet' or 'what happens next', with one status and a few steps
avoid_when: a list of tasks the person still has to do: use setup-steps
a finished action with its reference number: use receipt
something that failed and can be retried: use error-retry
a live delivery on a map: use delivery-tracker

parts.name: status
parts.what: where it is now, in a pill whose colour and icon follow the tone

parts.name: progress
parts.what: a bar and the share done, when a share is known

parts.name: steps
parts.what: one step: done, now or next, with an optional time

parts.name: updated
parts.what: when the status was last checked

empty.how: with no steps and no progress, only the title and the status line show

loading.how: keep the card and show the status pill and two steps as muted blocks

error.how: the danger tone turns the status pill red with a cross icon, for a step that failed

overflow.how: up to six steps stack down the card; the line between markers grows with each step's text

long_text.how: the title, status, step labels and times wrap and break long words; the share beside the bar never wraps
